_doc: Fragments the two add-on builds merge into three-party/labels.json, the served label map, key by key. Build V (menu and trace) adds the four keys under keys and the trace block. Build E (try your own invoice) appends the scene row under scenes and the two stepColumns entries. Every other visible word of the add-ons is a key of view/copy.json converted from copy-block-c.txt. Nothing here is a displayed value except the scene strings and the key names.

scenes.title: Try your own invoice
scenes.text: Edit the invoice, add a hidden instruction, and see which check decides.
